merchant: Welcome, adventurer! Browse my fine selection of wares, rare metals, and catalysts.
The overworld trade routes have been perilous lately, but my inventory remains unmatched in Sunder.
Bring me rare monster shards and refined ingots, and I'll ensure you get top coin.
A sharp blade is good, but a well-stocked pack of provisions is what keeps you breathing out there.
Trade caravans bring exotic goods from the Vanguard Hold—have a look before stock runs dry!
blacksmith: Looking for sturdy steel, tempered plate, or a razor edge? You came to the right anvil.
Good metal isn't cheap, but it's cheaper than a tombstone out in the monster-infested wilds.
Keep your gear repaired. A dull blade or cracked chestplate is a death sentence in the Abyss.
Infusing elemental catalysts into raw ore turns ordinary steel into legendary weapons. Try it at the forge!
The furnace burns night and day. Hammering steel is the only melody that keeps Sunder standing.
apothecary: Potions, elemental catalysts, and alchemical remedies... what ails your soul, traveler?
Harvesting wild mandrake roots and monster shards yields remarkably potent concoctions.
A single health potion or mana elixir can be the thin line between triumph and disaster.
Alchemical catalysts can empower your crafted gear with burning flame, frozen frost, or crackling shock!
Handle those crystal phials with care—one misstep with volatile catalysts will singe your eyebrows!
tavern_master: Pull up a oak bench! Have a cold mug of frothy dwarven ale or warm hearth stew.
Travelers pass through here daily. Sit by the fire if you're hunting for regional rumors and bounty tips.
Nothing cures overworld exhaustion or blizzard chills quite like a hot meal and a good night's rest.
Bards sing tales of the Deep Abyss and its mythical guardians... most are tall tales, but some are true!
Keep the peace in my tavern, friend! The guards don't take kindly to brawls near the bar.
guard: Keep your weapon sheathed within settlement boundaries, traveler. Order is maintained here.
Watchtowers keep Sunder safe from outlaw raids and beast swarms. Support your local faction!
Report any suspicious activity, outlaw cultists, or wild beast sightings directly to the watch commander.
The roads beyond the gates grow dark at dusk. Keep a torch lit and your shield ready.
Sunder's walls have stood for generations against the Abyss monsters. We'll hold the line.
scholar: Fascinating! The ancient runes etched upon the Abyss obelisks predate the Great Fracture.
Did you know? Moon phases deeply influence monster aggression and rare catalyst spawn rates!
Knowledge is the sharpest weapon of all. Study your enemy's archetype before striking.
relic_hunter: Ah, a fellow seeker of forgotten treasures! The deep dungeons hide relics of unmatched power.
If you stumble upon Sanctum Relics on your dungeon delves, hold onto them—they grant passive miracles!
I've searched ruined temples across Sunder. Danger is high, but the spoils are divine.

quests.title: Clear the Wild Wolves
quests.description: Defeat 3 wild wolves terrorizing the settlement borders.

quests.title: Supply Oakhaven Timber
quests.description: Collect 5 Oakhaven Timber logs for the blacksmith forge.

quests.title: Claim a Watchtower
quests.description: Reach and secure a regional watchtower for your faction.
